rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing a person who is not friendly.

example.english: That new colleague is unfriendly to people.
example.traditional: 嗰個新同事對人唔友善。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 san1 tung4 si6 deoi3 jan4 m4 jau5 sin6

rows.note: Use this stronger word when “unfriendly” means hostile, fierce, or mean rather than merely unwelcoming.

example.english: That dog is unfriendly, so don’t get so close.
example.traditional: 嗰隻狗好惡，唔好行咁埋。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 hou2 ngok3 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai4

rows.note: Use this for circumstances, conditions, or developments that are unfavourable to someone or something.

example.english: These conditions are unfriendly to small businesses.
example.traditional: 呢啲條件對小商戶唔利。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 tiu4 gin6 deoi3 siu2 soeng1 wu6 m4 lei6
